title: Acceptance Criteria Extractor output
summary: Extract testable acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then) for each discovered requirement. Criteria must be observable and falsifiable; do not invent features. Worker id retained for backward compatibility (role_alias=acceptance-criteria-extractor).

entries.statement: Given a user in household H, when they list accounts, then only H-scoped accounts are returned.
Given an expense is resolved to a jar, when jar_movement is created, then the linked account balance is unchanged by that movement alone.
